decisions.reason: As a flagship product line closely tied to the firm's core glass-processing and packaging capabilities, it still looks worth keeping open because the strategic upside in high-value connectivity applications remains meaningful while continuation costs are likely moderate and not enough negative evidence has emerged to justify abandonment.

Because this newly launched, strategically highlighted structuring technology builds directly on existing know-how and serves attractive semiconductor applications, management would likely preserve the option for another year since uncertainty is still high and it is too early to conclude that its value will not materialize.
